mapper.select: select oi.ticket_name as ticketName, ifnull(sum(oi.qty),0) as qty, ifnull(sum(oi.amount_cent),0) as amountCent from ticket_order_item oi join ticket_order o on oi.order_id=o.id where o.scenic_id=#{scenicId} and o.created_at between #{start} and #{end} and o.status in ('PAID','USED','REFUNDING','RESCHEDULING','RESCHEDULED') group by oi.ticket_name order by qty desc
